'''October 2000 Boulder tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Boulder, Colorado on 29 October 2000. [[Brian Hunter]] won it. It is known from Brian Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1404">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-30-boulder-co-10-29-00-business-as-usuald1404/ boulder-co-10-29-00-business-as-usual], DeckTech (Brian "HuntaWarya" Hunter, 30 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-30-boulder-co-10-29-00-business-as-usuald1404/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 29 October 2000
* '''Site:''' Boulder, Colorado
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Brian Hunter]]
